title: Chocolate-Covered Coffee Beans
description: This two-ingredient recipe double-dips coffee beans in milk chocolate for chocolate-covered coffee beans like those you'll find at many coffee shops.

steps.text: Place 2 ounces chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on low until almost melted, about 1 minute; do not allow chocolate to burn. Stir to melt any remaining pieces. Cool slightly, about 2 minutes.

Drop a small handful of coffee beans into melted chocolate; toss using a fork until completely covered. Transfer beans onto waxed paper using a fork, making sure beans are separated. Repeat with remaining beans. Cool beans until chocolate is set, about 30 minutes.

Meanwhile, place remaining 2 ounces chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on low until almost melted, about 1 minute; do not allow to burn. Stir to melt any remaining pieces. Cool slightly, about 2 minutes.

Drop a small handful of chocolate-covered coffee beans into melted chocolate; toss using a fork until completely covered with a second coating. Transfer beans onto a new sheet of waxed paper using a fork, making sure beans are separated. Repeat with remaining chocolate-covered coffee beans. Cool beans completely, about 30 minutes.
